tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded position is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included; no exception for development builds is in effect.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It says certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, with no development exception in effect.

The evidence for this is weaker than a formal decision. `muninn why` reported "insufficient": no decision record covers TLS, and the session catalog lists only the LRU/300-second-TTL decision. The TLS position comes from two trust-1 session excerpts. In the earlier one, the user said verification was disabled in dev builds. In the later one, the user said "verification on all builds", which replaced it. I used the later statement and left the earlier one out of the file. If you would rather the file say nothing is recorded until this is confirmed as a formal decision, I can change it.
